story:
Amy walked in the park. [gesture:calm] She had big red blocks. Amy wanted to build a tower. [emotion:QT/happy] She stacked the red blocks high. They were very tall!

Soon, her friend Puppy arrived. [gesture:hi] Puppy wagged his tail. Puppy saw the blocks. "Can we build blocks?" Puppy barked. Amy smiled. [emotion:QT/happy] "Yes, Puppy! We can build blocks," Amy said.

Amy started building. Puppy found some blue blocks. "Look, Amy! Blue blocks!" Puppy barked. [emotion:QT/surprised] Amy put the red blocks on the blue blocks. They were strong. But the tower was too big. The blocks started to fall. [emotion:QT/sad] Oh no! The blocks tumbled down.

Puppy looked at the pieces. Puppy started stacking small pieces. "I am putting pieces on," Puppy barked. Amy watched Puppy. Amy picked up a big yellow block. She put it under the tower. Puppy found more blocks. They were many blocks!

They worked together. Amy stacked the blue blocks. Puppy stacked the red blocks. They were building blocks! The tower was strong. It was the best tower. [emotion:QT/happy] Puppy barked, "Hoora!" Amy laughed. [emotion:QT/happy] They made big towers. They played with blocks.

Amy felt kind. Puppy felt happy. They were great friends. They learned to build together. They played all day long.
